caption: The drawing depicts two main objects positioned vertically on a plain, off-white background. In the upper part of the drawing, there is a round, brown medallion or seal with a raised image of an animal’s head, possibly a bear or a dog, placed at the center, and surrounded by a sunburst pattern. Around the edge of the medallion, there is a ring of raised lettering and numbers. Below the medallion, in the lower part of the drawing, there is a brown lidded vessel made of what appears to be ceramic or clay. The vessel has a wide mouth, a rounded body that narrows slightly at the base, and two handles; the handle on the right side is separated from the vessel body and appears twisted, while the left handle is attached normally. The lid of the vessel features an openwork design that incorporates letters and numbers in a raised script and is topped with a sculpted figure of an animal, possibly a lamb or dog, in a lying position. The surface of the vessel is decorated with a combination of diamond, star, and wave motifs in shades of brown, blue, and reddish hues.
title: Pa. German Tobacco Bowl w/ Lid
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
